name: phantom islands
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Phantom islands are seen on some seas, or near certain lakes. They appear and seem to move in the haze. Natives once tied them to the Otherworld. They were said to be the homes of fairies. No ship reaches them. The sight stays in the story of the west.

okr.objective: Describe phantom islands as Otherworld sights in the mist.
key_results: A phantom island appears on sea or lake.
It was held to be a home of fairy folk.
